articles.content: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and costs $4.99 (free over $75). Express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $12.99. You can track your order from the confirmation email link. If your order has not arrived after 7 business days, contact support with your order number so we can open an investigation with the carrier.
articles.title: Shipping times and order tracking

articles.content: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-10 business days after we receive the item. To start a return, reply with your order number and reason. Damaged or wrong items are replaced free of charge and return shipping is on us.
articles.title: Returns and refunds policy

articles.content: To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the login page and enter your account email. You will receive a reset link valid for 30 minutes. If you cannot log in after resetting, clear your browser cookies or try an incognito window. Locked out after 5 attempts? Wait 15 minutes and try again.
articles.title: How to reset your password

articles.content: Getting started checklist: 1) Verify your email with the link we sent. 2) Complete your company profile. 3) Connect your first integration from Settings > Integrations. 4) Invite your team. 5) Book the welcome call. Most teams reach their first value moment within a day. Reply to the welcome email any time for help.
articles.title: Getting started and onboarding checklist

articles.content: Plans: Starter (free, up to 3 seats), Pro ($29/seat/month, unlimited tickets), Scale ($99/seat/month, SSO and audit log), Enterprise (custom pricing, dedicated support and SLA). Annual billing saves 20%. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel from Settings > Billing at any time.
articles.title: Pricing plans and discounts

articles.content: To set up the API integration: 1) Create an API key in Settings > Developers. 2) Authenticate with header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. 3) POST tickets to /v1/tickets. Auth errors (401) almost always mean a revoked or mistyped key — regenerate it. Rate limit is 600 requests/minute. SDKs exist for Python and Node.
articles.title: API setup and authentication errors

articles.content: Invoices are issued on the first day of each month and charged to your card on file. If you were charged twice, check whether one charge is a temporary authorization hold (it drops within 3 days). For real duplicate charges, send us the invoice numbers and we refund within 5 business days. Download past invoices from Settings > Billing.
articles.title: Invoices and duplicate charges

articles.content: All hardware includes a 12-month warranty covering manufacturing defects. Batteries and accessories are covered for 6 months. Warranty does not cover accidental damage, but our repair program offers flat-rate fixes. To file a claim, provide your order number and a photo of the issue.
articles.title: Warranty coverage and claims

articles.content: New accounts must verify their email before ordering: click the verification link sent at signup (check spam). The link expires after 24 hours; request a new one from Settings > Account. Business accounts may also need domain verification via DNS TXT record.
articles.title: Account and email verification

articles.content: SSO is available on Scale and Enterprise plans. We support SAML 2.0 (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace). Setup: go to Settings > Security > SSO, upload your IdP metadata XML, then map the email claim. Enforce SSO for all members once tested. Contact support to enable SCIM provisioning.
articles.title: Configuring SSO (SAML)
